svg.title: Measured repository telemetry
svg.desc: Measured telemetry: 59 public non-fork repositories, 4194 commits on default branches, and a language distribution of TypeScript 49.1 percent, Go 20.4 percent, Vue 16.9 percent, JavaScript 4.5 percent, with 9.1 percent across all other languages, measured over 14.89 MB of public source across 59 repositories on 2026-08-23.
